title: Best AI Flyer Generators in 2026
summary: The best AI flyer generators of 2026, free options first: 7 flyer makers compared by job, free plan and price, checked on each maker's own pages.
body_markdown:
## How do you choose an AI flyer generator?


Start from how much text the flyer has to carry, then check whether you can download it free, whether it takes your logo, and where the flyer will be seen, in that order.


1.


### 1


Count the text


A poster with one headline suits any tool, but a line-up, a menu or a timetable needs a model that sets dense text accurately, so test one busy flyer first.


2.


### 2


Check the download


Free plans differ most at export: some download free, some charge per high-quality file, and some share a link but hold back downloads until you pay.


3.


### 3


Bring your brand


A logo, product photo or venue picture as a reference keeps the flyer yours, so check that the tool takes uploads on the plan you use.


4.


### 4


Plan where it runs


A print flyer needs a high-resolution file, while a flyer for social media gains from a short animated version that moves in the feed.
